sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The chart below shows estimated world literacy rates by region and by gender for the year 2000. Write a report for a university lecturer describing the information below. Write at least 150 words.

Although more and more people are reading the news in the internet most people still prefer reading the news in a newspaper. What are your views? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
